messages:
Tara (Marketing): Quick check — we want to push the public announcement tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog snippet + canonical docs link (stable) and the playbook for canary timing. Can engineering confirm windows and any rollout constraints? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon (Eng): Can do 09:00 PT start. Plan: canary for 2 hours (09:00-11:00 PT) at 5% traffic, then 25% for 30m, then ramp to 100% if metrics OK. Will post PR and deploy details in a sec.
Tara (Marketing): Perfect. Also need a docs URL we can link in the blog and the newsletter. And the changelog blurb we can paste.
Priyanka (Docs): Draft is ready at https://docs.redwood.ai/whats-new/187345 — stable slug. ETA: 30m for final edits. I'll add a short TL;DR changelog we can use.
Devon (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 — deploy job is green. Note: there's a config toggle net.new_feature.enable_quant_routing=true behind FF: "quant_routing_v2". We'll keep it off during canary unless we see perf gains.
alex_m: Heads up — the model variant for the announcement is rwd-v2-qa-lit (quantized). If we see latency > 120ms p50 we'll fallback to rwd-v2-qa (non-quant) automatically via routing policy.
Tara (Marketing): Nice. For copy we need: 1) one-sentence headline, 2) 2-line changelog bullet, 3) link to docs, 4) webinar CTA link. Can Priyanka paste the exact changelog bullet?
Priyanka (Docs): Changlog bullet: "Reduced inference p50 by ~25% for long-context chat; added prefix KV-caching to cut token costs on repeated prompts." — you can use exactly that. Docs page above contains sample curl and SDK snippets.
Tara (Marketing): Webinar is set for same day at 11:30 PT — we'll put CTA in top of the post. Need the webinar registration link and an embed (iframe) url.
Sam (Ops): Webhook and SFDC mapping are ready. Inbound leads from the webinar and contact form will POST to https://ingest.redwood.ai/leads with headers x-team:marketing. Fields: email, name, company, utm_source, utm_campaign, product_tag. Sales mapping: campaign ID "Q2-launch-187345".
alex_m: For tracking please use utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2 and utm_source=blog. Also add utm_medium=email for newsletter variants.
Tara (Marketing): Good. Who's owner for the embargo window? We need a hard freeze on docs/content edits 30m before announce.
Devon (Eng): Release owner: Devon. No infra pushes during canary window. If critical infra patch required, ping me directly, we'll coordinate.
Priyanka (Docs): Freeze acknowledged. I'll lock the docs page at 08:30 PT.
Devon (Eng): Monitoring: We'll watch p50, p95 latency, error-rate, and token-cost-per-request. If any of these exceed thresholds (p50>150ms or error-rate >0.5%) — abort and rollback to previous deploy. Rollback procedure in PR description.
Tara (Marketing): OK — action items: 
- Devon: post final deploy tids + canary start time in this thread (please)
- Priyanka: paste final changelog bullet + canonical docs link (stable) 
- Sam: confirm lead webhook test endpoint and example payload
- Alex: provide the two UTM variants for blog vs newsletter
I'll assemble announcement copy once those are in.
Devon (Eng): Canary starts 1873456800 (09:00:00 PT). Deploy TIDs: tid-2026-04-05-1147 and tid-2026-04-05-1148. Canary duty: me and @alex_m.
release-bot: deploy tid-2026-04-05-1147 completed to canary pool (5%) — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1147
Tara (Marketing): Thanks. Priyanka, anything to add?
Priyanka (Docs): Final changelog bullet (copy-ready): "Performance: ~25% lower median inference latency for long-context chat; added prefix KV-caching to reduce repeated prompt costs. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/whats-new/187345 (canonical)"
Sam (Ops): Webhook test payload sample (POST /test-lead):
```json
{
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "company": "Acme Co.",
  "utm_source": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "prod_launch_q2",
  "product_tag": "rwd-v2-qa"
}
```
Sam (Ops): Test endpoint responded 200 OK. Forwarding to SFDC campaign Q2-launch-187345.
alex_m: UTM variants — blog: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2; newsletter: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2. Use &product_tag=rwd-v2-qa for all links.
Tara (Marketing): This is great — I'll queue the post in CMS and schedule at 09:00 PT with the webinar CTA at top. Will post final copy here for sign-off at 08:45 PT. :rocket:
Devon (Eng): Copy received. We'll escalate on-call if any anomalies pop.
release-bot: canary policy triggered: autoscale hold enabled.
Tara (Marketing): Closing thread — thanks everyone. Final sign-off in 45m.
